title: Deploy Without Dropping Active Requests
description: Every deploy causes connection resets because a healthy app process exits while the balancer still routes to it. Which shutdown sequence addresses this?

options.text: Exit first, then let health checks discover the loss.
options.explanation: Requests routed before detection still reach a stopped process and fail.

options.text: Stop new routing through readiness, drain in-flight work, then exit within a timeout.
options.explanation: Readiness removes the instance from new traffic while existing work finishes. A bounded drain avoids waiting forever.

options.text: Enable sticky sessions so users stay on the exiting node.
options.explanation: Affinity does not keep a stopped process alive and can pin users to the failed instance.

options.text: Retry each failure without a total attempt limit.
options.explanation: Unbounded retries can amplify the deploy's disruption and do not fix shutdown ordering.
